Dr Oliver Bimber has been researching the combination of computer graphics and holograms. Here is a video summarizing the research which is about to end:

[http://www.uni-weimar.de/~bimber/Pub/Ho ... _Final.avi](http://www.uni-weimar.de/~bimber/Pub/HoloGraphics_Final.avi)

(88Mb file)

Dr Bimber wrote about his work in the Holographer:

[http://www.holographer.org/articles/hg0 ... 00011.html](http://www.holographer.org/articles/hg00011/hg00011.html)
